purpose: Independent vertical-shape sensitivity: replace aerosol_default vertical optical-depth distribution by CAMS total-aerosol extinction shape while holding each Taylor row's previously frozen AOD550 and all other 550-nm MYSTIC settings fixed.

helperSource.role: reuse already-proven generic 550-nm MYSTIC rendering/parsing only; CAMS profile construction and fresh seeds are separate

cams.selectionReason: The 2025-08-08 00Z cycle's lead-0 aerext532 diagnostic is identically zero while lead-3 is valid; before viewing any CAMS-MYSTIC result, use one internally consistent prior 12Z cycle at leads 12/15 to provide nonzero valid-00Z/03Z vertical shapes. Current-cycle AOD amount is not imported here because row-specific AOD550 was already frozen independently.
cams.interpolation: linear in valid time and geometric height of extinction coefficient; integrate on exact libRadtran site grid; normalize layer optical depths to unity per row before applying the original frozen row AOD550
cams.role: total-aerosol vertical-shape constraint only; not a post-hoc AOD fit

mystic.spectralMode: true monochromatic wavelength 550 nm; no ALIS
mystic.profileWavelengthNote: CAMS 532-nm extinction supplies normalized vertical shape only; aerosol_default optical-property family and row AOD550 remain fixed

analysis.primaryOutput: direct delta magnitude at 550 nm, CAMS-shape minus aerosol_default, per row and aggregate
analysis.orientationOnly: subtract direct 550-nm delta from the already frozen broadband observed-minus-model residual; do not call this a revised broadband validation
